mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plans ( task_id, user_id, title, region, summary, total_days, start_location_query, end_location_query, trip_start_time, trip_end_time, full_day_start_time, full_day_end_time, destination_buffer_min, created_at ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{region}, #{summary}, #{totalDays}, #{startLocationQuery}, #{endLocationQuery}, #{tripStartTime}, #{tripEndTime}, #{fullDayStartTime}, #{fullDayEndTime}, #{destinationBufferMin}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO plan_steps ( plan_id, step_order, day_number, attraction_name, latitude, longitude, estimated_duration_min, traffic_time_from_prev, weather_note, llm_description, planned_start_time, planned_end_time, travel_time_to_destination_min, created_at ) VALUES ( #{planId}, #{stepOrder}, #{dayNumber}, #{attractionName}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{estimatedDurationMin}, #{trafficTimeFromPrev}, #{weatherNote}, #{llmDescription}, #{plannedStartTime}, #{plannedEndTime}, #{travelTimeToDestinationMin}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO plan_steps ( plan_id, step_order, day_number, attraction_name, latitude, longitude, estimated_duration_min, traffic_time_from_prev, weather_note, llm_description, planned_start_time, planned_end_time, travel_time_to_destination_min, created_at ) VALUES
( #{s.planId}, #{s.stepOrder}, #{s.dayNumber}, #{s.attractionName}, #{s.latitude}, #{s.longitude}, #{s.estimatedDurationMin}, #{s.trafficTimeFromPrev}, #{s.weatherNote}, #{s.llmDescription}, #{s.plannedStartTime}, #{s.plannedEndTime}, #{s.travelTimeToDestinationMin}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM plans WHERE task_id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM plans WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM plans WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM plan_steps WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY step_order ASC
